name: Arjuna
summary: In BhG 7–9 the addressee; he asks the seven questions of 8.1–2 (Brahman, adhyātma, karma, adhibhūta, adhidaiva, adhiyajña, knowing the Lord at death) and is told to remember Kṛṣṇa and fight (8.7).

name: Kṛṣṇa
summary: In BhG 7–9 the speaker (śrī bhagavān), who names himself Vāsudeva (7.19) and is addressed by Arjuna as Puruṣottama and Madhusūdana (8.1–2); he teaches himself as the source and dissolution of the world, the adhiyajña in the body, the one to be remembered at death, and the recipient of all worship.
